annotation.title_clean: 国务院关于《支持北京深化国家服务业扩大开放综合示范区建设工作方案》的批复
annotation.title_en: State Council Reply on the Work Plan for Supporting Beijing in Deepening the Construction of the National Comprehensive Demonstration Zone for Expanded Opening-up of the Services Sector
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.summary_en: State Council reply approving the work plan to deepen Beijing's national services-sector opening-up demonstration zone. It covers telecom, health, finance, digital economy and data rules, trade facilitation and risk control. AI-relevant items are minor: exploring AI governance standards and sandbox supervision for autonomous driving and data trading.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves the Beijing services-sector opening-up work plan and assigns the Ministry of Commerce to coordinate and evaluate it
Supports Beijing in exploring AI governance standards research and rule-building
Calls for data classification guidelines and important-data catalogues for autonomous driving
Calls for full-chain 'sandbox supervision' for autonomous driving and data trading scenarios
Strengthens risk prevention in finance, data security, biosecurity and culture
